name: 13F Screener
note: Leave an email, get a link back. Read-only; filings to 1 June 2026.
noteIt: Lasci una email e ricevi un link. Sola lettura; filing fino al 1 giugno 2026.

data.refresh: Run `python -m demo.freeze_demo_data` against a current live DuckDB, commit demo/fixtures/, then `bash deploy-site.sh`.

killSwitch.note: Unset or false and the demo routes 404, nothing can be minted, and the API reads the live database again.

auth.note: An address gets a signed link, good for 30 minutes; following it mints a 4-hour session cookie. Nothing is stored: both tokens are stateless HMACs. The gate proves someone can read an inbox — it is not protecting the data, which is public SEC filings.

resets: Read-only against a frozen snapshot — nothing to reset. Sessions expire on their own and leave nothing behind.
